checkpoints.title: RNA·Protein QC/정규화
checkpoints.pass_criteria: QC report on actual quantitative matrices, identifier harmonization, missingness/batch
checkpoints.observation: Source-pinned Suter HCCfull RDS T/P 50-biopsy numeric-layer QA verified; zero nonfinite values across 20,356 T and 5,585 P features, global negatives and zero patterns audited; exact T/P row-label overlap 0 due to Ensembl-versus-protein identifier namespaces. S5 Appendix imputation, normalization and exact feature gene mapping not yet reviewed. Suter public HCCinfo RDS source gene mapping directly verifies 188 reduced RNA, 116 reduced protein features and 114 one-to-one shared gene labels, but full feature ID crosswalk still missing and S5 normalization remains unreviewed. Stage23 latest completed CI measured 5,390 mapped proteome features / 5,437 distinct Ensembl genes (union incl. ambiguous links), 43 multi-gene features and 5,343 one-to-one genes; 5,490 paper comparable count NOT exact reproduced mapping; JSON-vs-TSV provenance correction queued on feasibility branch. Stage24 source SHA256 RDS 20,356T×5,585P with 5,343 mapped strict pair correlation descriptive QC passed; no preimputation missingness/batch documentation or original Ng 2022 normalization reproduction yet. Stage25 final PLOS published S5 official PDF 97109 bytes SHA256 2ab792e2a5b2445c5e5d702e09dd957eeff42b8e3e158716da6fd2caab4bd26a fetched in CI. Text section indicators RNA upper quartile to1000/log2, protein log2/filter+clustering-only imputation/unimputed DE, PP separate batch correction. Automated keyword flags are not exact source RDS T/P transformation validation; method/lineage review required. Stage25 final-S5 publisher source parser corrected and verified median-subtraction ('substraction') in proteome & phosphoproteome, upper-quartile normalized log2 transcriptome, protein and PP clustering-only imputation/unimputed DE, PP-only source batch-correction indicator. Source-article method audit remains distinct from HCCfull numerical preprocessing reproduction. Stage26 source-pinned numeric full/fullz comparison revealed RNA T 20,356 vs 19,768 features (588 excluded), matching all 50 biopsies; fullz T/P/PP per-gene SD median 1, but median absolute residual to direct per-gene scale(full) T=0.780626 P=0.826316 PP=0.795543. This rules out simple same-axis zscore identity, not the original production transformation lineage. Stage27 full vs fullz after exact feature/50-biopsy label alignment: within-feature Spearman across 50 samples median M/CN=1 but T=-0.002431585 (19768 shared), P=0.024057623 (5585), PP=0.037118848 (7889). This is not simple monotonic row normalization; current observed source generation unknown; additional sample-permutation forensic pending. Stage27b CI #41185636861 four jobs SUCCESS: 50 source samples best-match position same-label M 50/50, CN 46/50, RNA T 2/50, Protein P 2/50, PP 2/50. T/P/PP each form one-to-one inferred 50-sample permutation, row-standardized sample-similarity best medians T 0.80011227, P 0.79190709, PP 0.77786129 (NOT bounded correlation coefficients). Cross-omic shared permutation and original patient metadata consistency are NOT proven. Stage28 CI #41186682016 successful independent disjoint-gene training/holdout: T 19768, P 5585, PP 7889 features split 50:50, identical T/P/PP inferred 50/50 sample permutation, train vs reverse-holdout inferred 50/50; same named column positions only 2/50. On independently heldout features original across-RDS Spearman median T=-0.001872749/P=0.024345738/PP=0.036110444, after candidate permutation T=P=PP=1.000000, fraction heldout features rho>0.95 after mapping 100%. This proves rank-level source sample permutation explanation but not which sample names truly correspond to original patients or exact numerical z-score transform. Stage28B actual GitHub CI #41187009479 SUCCESS on independently held-out features: after common 50-biopsy column permutation, HCCfullz T/P/PP equals row-standardized HCCfull at better than 1e-6 on 100% tested cells, with max abs residual rounded to 0 at 9 decimals; before candidate order correction median absolute residual T=0.780477824 P=0.824260984 PP=0.795386541. Thus rank and numeric scaling differences are explained by one common sample-column permutation + gene-wise zscore for shared source features. 588 RNA features absent from fullz and original biopsy label orientation remain unverified. Stage29 source RNA feature exclusion independent CI #41187760168 SUCCESS: all 588/588 HCCfull RNA rows absent from HCCfullz have SD exactly 0 across 50 source biopsy columns; retained 0/19768 are constant (minimum SD 0.008226619). This resolves exact membership selection as zero-variance gene row filtering at operational source-object level. Author-generated original preprocessing script not verified. Stage29 run #41188805830 separately successful patient-label job: full/fullz have same 50 biopsy label sets, within each RDS T/P/PP share order, but full vs fullz orders differ; cross-source numeric-matched biopsy/patient label agrees only 2/50, different source patient groups 48/50. This demonstrates a serious cross-object patient phenotype misattribution risk. No authoritative biological label orientation has been independently validated.
checkpoints.next_action: Critical V03 HOLD_LABEL_ORIENTATION: candidate full-to-fullz numeric bijection maps 48/50 profiles to different official patient labels. Avoid using HCCfullz clinical phenotype joins until original author/source manifest corroborates correct real biopsy identity. Stage28 source RDS object numerical relation and 588 zero-SD filter are GO_TECHNICAL, not manuscript biology.

checkpoints.title: RNA–Protein concordance
checkpoints.pass_criteria: patient-level mapped gene/protein association + uncertainty + FDR
checkpoints.observation: Stage24 real public Ng/Suter processed 5,343 strict one-gene-one-protein feature pairs, 50 biopsies/48 distinct patients, source-pinned aggregate Spearman across patients: median rho=0.284086 q10=-0.052106 q90=0.627182; 46 single-biopsy patients median=0.284490, 50 nonindependent biopsies median=0.282881. All 5343 defined, positive rho fraction=0.858132; no gene-level p-value/FDR/CI or independent replication. Ng paper median 0.287 is not exact reproduction due processed measurement and gene universe differences. Stage25 patient-wise 48x leave-one-out median rho 0.273127 to 0.292900 (max 0.010959 departure from baseline 0.284086); fixed-seed 80x patient bootstrap empirical rho median interval 0.243922 to 0.329928. Technical source/aggregate postflight SUCCESS, not gene-level CI, FDR, batch/purity control or external replication. Stage26 official Ng Source Data SuppFig13g (NOT main Fig2b) contains 5481 distinct published ENSG gene IDs, 5253 overlap with current strict 5343, 228 published-only, 90 current-only; this is a supplement-specific set comparison, NOT exact original Fig2b source gene-set verification. Preliminary earlier output falsely labelled physical sheet28 as Fig2b, corrected via workbook relationships. Stage27 negative cross-RDS control: processed T/P/PP values from HCCfull are not rank-preserved in HCCfullz despite same feature ID and same labeled 50 biopsy columns. Stage24 rho 0.284086 strictly dataset-specific until provenance explained; cannot use fullz as a direct Spearman sensitivity substitute. D-038 SOURCE CORRECTION: earlier D-036 assertion that 5481 gene set was SuppFig13g was caused by lexicographically sorting worksheet XML paths then treating array position as sheet number. True file was sheet8.xml = original Fig2b (5481 ENSG source genes, published Spearman rho median 0.287059), paired with sheet7.xml = original Fig2a (15272 ENSG, rho median 0.203142). Thus actual original Figure2b gene ID overlap with current strict 5343 is 5253, original-only 228, current-only 90. Provenance GO, source correlation effect replication NOT done. Corrected Stage26-v3 official actual Fig2b original membership verification #41185931131 (all three jobs SUCCESS) confirms 5481 original Ng ENSG IDs vs 5343 strict current mapped ENSG IDs, intersection 5253, 228 original-only, 90 mapped-only. This is primary source gene membership GO; original published per-gene rho numerical reproduction HOLD. Stage29 original actual Fig2b effect vector job 124499343862 within workflow #41188201726 SUCCESS: exactly 5253 shared genes, 48 independent patient-mean primary source median rho 0.285931394 vs original same-5253 rho median 0.292669683, paired per-gene effect Pearson 0.975014947, Spearman 0.972556921, sign agreement 0.961736151, median absolute rho diff 0.026940583 and fraction |delta|>0.2 0.011612412. Naive 50 biopsies effect-vector Spearman 0.976246752/sign 0.965733866; singleton 46 Spearman 0.966590844/sign 0.955834761. These are within-source corroboration from published Ng cohort, NOT external independent patient replication, and original expression/RSEM/normal-reference pipeline not reproduced. Whole CI workflow #41188201726 failed in a separate patient-label job; the named Fig2b job succeeded.
checkpoints.next_action: V07 GO_TECHNICAL_FIG2B_EFFECT_CORROBORATION 5253 genes; HOLD_ORIGINAL_RAW_RECONSTRUCTION, HOLD_EXTERNAL_PATIENT_REPLICATION and HOLD_BIOLOGICAL_CLAIM. Independently obtain matched Gao 2019 patient RNA and proteome sample-quantitative matrices, verify original sample identity/annotation and fit same prespecified per-gene/pathway estimand. Do not claim new discovery from within-source agreement.
